itens.titulo: CVE-2026-19868: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN Use of Single-factor Authentication Vulnerability
itens.resumo: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN contains a use of single-factor authentication vulnerability that may allow a user with valid credentials for an alternate authentication method to bypass SAML authentication controls. Successful exploitation may also bypass SAML-enforced multi-factor authentication (MFA).

itens.titulo: Installing the Fix for an Exploited WordPress Flaw Can Expose Some Sites One Last Time
itens.resumo: Some WordPress sites can still be attacked while they install the fix for an actively exploited flaw, according to Umut Bayram, the Picus Security researcher who found it. The update that installs the fix still unpacks its files using the site's old, unpatched code, so an attacker who strikes at the right moment can run code on the server.
